# Ledger events

Every event type a tool or the hook writes to `LEDGER.log` (the append-only log; agents write it and never read it), and who writes it.

| event | written by |
|---|---|
| `APPROVE` | bin/_approval.py |
| `ASK-APPROVE` | .claude/hooks/sandbox.py |
| `BIND` | .claude/hooks/sandbox.py |
| `CALL` | .claude/hooks/sandbox.py |
| `CHECK` | bin/check |
| `CHECK-KEPT` | bin/check |
| `CLAIM` | bin/ledger-claims |
| `CLAIM-APPROVAL` | bin/ledger-claims |
| `CLAIM-NOTE` | bin/annotate-claim |
| `CLAIMS-EXTRACT` | bin/claims-extract |
| `CLOSE-RUN` | bin/close-run |
| `DENY` | .claude/hooks/sandbox.py |
| `DENY-GATE` | .claude/hooks/sandbox.py |
| `DONE` | .claude/hooks/sandbox.py |
| `ERROR` | .claude/hooks/sandbox.py |
| `EXIT-EXT` | bin/run-external |
| `EXT-SESSION` | bin/astra-session |
| `HANDOFF-ARCHIVE` | .claude/hooks/sandbox.py |
| `LAUNCH-EXT` | bin/run-external |
| `MERGE` | bin/merge |
| `NEW` | bin/new-run |
| `NOTE` | .claude/hooks/sandbox.py |
| `PACKET-BLOCK` | bin/packet-block |
| `PACKET-EXCEPT` | bin/packet-except |
| `QUEUE-RUN` | bin/run-external |
| `QUEUE-START` | bin/run-external |
| `QUEUE-STOP` | bin/run-external |
| `RECORD-EXT` | bin/_ext.py |
| `REFUSED-EXT` | bin/run-external |
| `RETRY-EXT` | bin/run-external |
| `REWRITE` | .claude/hooks/sandbox.py |
| `START` | .claude/hooks/sandbox.py |
| `VERIFY-DATA` | bin/verify-data |
